visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame is a vertical split-screen. In the bottom half, a woman with extremely long black hair, wearing a white strapless dress and a large red flower in her hair, sits at a black grand piano, her back slightly to the camera as she plays. In the top half, a female singer with a red rose brooch on her white top sings into a spotlight against a dark studio background. (2) The top half cuts to a shot of a string ensemble including a male violinist and a cellist in a dimly lit, warm-toned studio space. The bottom half remains a continuous shot of the pianist's hands moving across the keyboard. (3) The top frame shows an acoustic guitar being played by a man in a patterned shirt, followed by text overlays appearing in the center. The setting is a professional music studio with acoustic panels and soft lighting. (4) The top half continues to cycle through shots of the singer, the string section (violin, cello, double bass), and the guitarist, while the bottom half remains fixed on the pianist's performance. The lighting in the top frame is cinematic with high contrast, while the bottom frame is evenly lit with neutral tones.
